svg.title: The roll curve, with Advantage and Disadvantage
svg.desc: Every core roll is 2d10 under a target, so lower is better. A normal roll centres on 11. Advantage keeps the lowest two of three dice and centres near 8.5; Disadvantage keeps the highest two and centres near 13.5. The shape is the same in each case - only its position moves, by about two and a half points either way.
svg.text: Centres: 8.5 · 11.0 · 13.5 — about two and a half points either way
